input.title: Elvis: As Recorded at Madison Square Garden

rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (21 tracks) per https://www.discogs.com/release/1619790-Elvis-Presley-Elvis-As-Recorded-At-Madison-Square-Garden, https://www.discogs.com/release/2099355-Elvis-Presley-Elvis-As-Recorded-At-Madison-Square-Garden. VERIFIED: original LP (RCA Victor LSP-4776, June 1972) has 21 indexed bands (12 side A + 9 side B), NOT 16 — including 'Introduction: Also Sprach Zarathustra' and 'Introductions by Elvis'. Recorded at the June 10, 1972 evening show, released ~1 week later. The modern 2LP reissue adds 'End Theme (Orchestra)' as track 22 — not on the original.
